gate.title: Choose a language
gate.description: The interface and the words on the cards will be in English.

home.intro: Online party games about academic life, played in the browser. Everyone joins the same room from their own phone or laptop: pick a nickname and you're in, with no sign-up.

keywords.name: Double Blind
keywords.summary: Two research groups race to find their keywords from one-word clues. Reveal Reviewer 2, and your paper is rejected.

impostor.name: Spot the Impostor
impostor.summary: Everyone gets the same term except one, who gets a close cousin.

titles.name: Real or Fake
titles.summary: Tell real paper titles from invented ones.

abstracts.name: Bluff the Abstract
abstracts.summary: Write a convincing abstract for a paper nobody has read.
